statement: Apocalypse is not destruction first, but unveiling.
gloss: The end begins when hidden structures become visible.
Collapse reveals what was real and what was theatrical.

statement: Every civilization carries its apocalypse as an internal accounting.
gloss: The end is prepared by the structure itself.

statement: The trumpet does not create the ruin; it announces what was already rotten.
gloss: Revelation names decay before it becomes undeniable.

statement: The last days are recognized by the inflation of false necessities.
gloss: A dying order multiplies obligations to hide its emptiness.
